question: What Delta-t maximises single-anchor concentration, and does the modal candidate cluster ever sit near truth?
hypothesis: s057's analytic Delta-t=10 choice was suboptimal; an empirical sweep will find a better Delta-t and possibly a modal cluster at truth.
narrative_md: Empirical Delta-t sweep at fixed anchor t_a=411 on seed 89: concentration peaks at dt=3 (3.87x) and dt=7 (3.42x), NOT at s057's dt=10 (1.79x). Best truth-adjacent omega error improves monotonically with dt (22deg at dt=2 -> 4deg at dt=20). Decisive: the modal cluster never sits near truth (always 40-86deg away) -- single-anchor architecture has no peak-at-truth. Measures vs truth-omega -- oracle-leak, N=1.
